system.description:
Your enhancements define the way you channel your power. Define two fields of augmentations (like Force and Insight, Agility and Analysis, Command and Resilience, or Social Manipulation and Stealth, etc.).

Augmentation Die: Before making an action roll that relates to one of your augmentation’s fields, you may spend an Echo to activate it and add 1d4 to the roll. This Augmentation Die increases at level 5 to 1d6.

Perfect Efficiency: If your Augmentation Die rolls its maximum value, you immediately regain the Echo spent to use this feature.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist

system.gmNotes: At level 5, change the resource die to d6. Spend Echo from the class feature that holds it: the system can only charge a cost to the resource on the same item, so this Echo cost is paid by hand. Add the rolled die to the action roll by hand; Perfect Efficiency is applied by hand too.
